T: Bernie's throwing a party. He just doesn't know it.
D: Two junior employees pretend their dead boss is alive at his beach house for the weekend.
P: Serve the cocktails when the guests turn up at Bernie's beach house.
S: Prawns poached 2 minutes, iced, served in glasses over iceberg with a sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, lemon and horseradish.
Chopped clams folded through cream cheese and sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and chives, with potato chips.
Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, brushed with soy, brown sugar and ginger, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky.
M: Lobster tails, clams, corn and small potatoes steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic and butter, tipped onto the table.
Sirloin marinated in soy, garlic and pineapple juice, grilled to medium-rare, with grilled pineapple and coconut rice.
W: Brown sugar and butter in the tin, pineapple rings and cherries on top, butter cake batter poured over, baked at 175C for 45 minutes, flipped.
K: 30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime, shaken with ice, mint on top.

s.how: Drain a tin of chopped clams, keeping a little juice. Fold into 200g cream cheese and 100g sour cream with lemon juice, a dash of Worcestershire and chives. Serve with a bag of potato chips.

Drain a tin of water chestnuts and wrap each in half a rasher of bacon, about 8 rashers in total. Brush with 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky.

m.how: Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 250ml white wine, 3 garlic cloves and 80g butter, then 1kg clams and 4 lobster tails. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.

w.how: Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar in a tin. Lay pineapple rings with a cherry in each. Beat 125g butter and 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Spread over and bake at 175C for 45 minutes. Flip out.

d.how: For each drink, shake 30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain over crushed ice and top with a mint sprig. Makes four.
